scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the printed model equations, the simulation parameter set, and the complete sensitivity paragraph and figure. The earlier same-family leptospirosis paper was inspected at its disease-free equilibrium and threshold formula. Related host-vector threshold and leptospirosis sensitivity literature was checked to delimit the novelty claim. The bundled checker verifies exact elasticities and the next-generation spectral radius. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding corrects invasion-threshold sensitivity, not the source's time-series simulations. It distinguishes the standard next-generation spectral radius from the threshold-equivalent human-generation normalization used in earlier literature. Disease-induced mortality has a negative mathematical sensitivity but is not proposed as a control intervention.
